newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangzhou Inv eases after new shr issue.
newsitem.headline: Guangzhou Inv eases after new shr issue.

text.p: Shares of Guangzhou Investment Co Ltd eased in early Friday trade following news it had raised HK$1.27 billion by issuing 320 million new shares to its parent.
"Investors used the news as an excuse to take profit since the shares have been rising more than 25 percent in the past two weeks," a broker said.
Guangzhou Investment shares were down HK$0.175 to HK$3.975 on volume of 335.94 million shares worth HK$1.34 billion.

The company said on Thursday its parent Yue Xiu Enterprises (Holdings) Ltd agreed to subscribe the new shares at HK$3.98 each after placing 320 million existing shares to private investors at the same price.
Brokers said the heavy turnover included the placement of the 320 million shares.

"News that the company planned to use the money raised to purchase property and hotels in China should be neutral to positive, so the downside on the shares seems to be limited due to keen demand for red chips," said Sean Li of Amsteel Securities.
